flags.reason: misreads-source: The example leaves modes off the tile and says 'on the installed package a Button in children starts at AppearanceBrand Secondary and Button / Size S'. The guide says the opposite for installed 0.1.78: 'a Button passed in children doesn't get its purple, size S look, so these examples set AppearanceBrand Secondary and Button / Size S on the tile'. The doDont Don't also says 'Without those modes it's gold and size M'. Without TILE modes this example renders the gold, size M Button the guide warns against.

misreads-source: It says 'the slotted Button needs no modes on the tile', but the guide says a bare Button in children is 'gold and size M, too loud for a header' unless the tile sets AppearanceBrand Secondary and Button / Size S. The guide says 'every example here does' set those modes.

notes: The package-type facts /facts/props/4, /5, /6, /12 and /13 contradict both the guide and the evidence for installed jfs-components 0.1.78. They look like they come from a different (later or unpublished) version. The evidence's contract lists every prop and has no actionLabel or onActionPress. It says children left out gives a placeholder Button with no onPress, and a passed Button gets only the tile's modes (gold, size M). It says disableTruncation affects only the title and the description never truncates. It says a static tile has no accessible name and is not announced by its title. The evidence's Limits forbid implying that the description truncates or wraps through disableTruncation, or that a static tile is announced by its title. I have not flagged the items that cite these facts, because they restate the cited facts faithfully. But each one misstates the guide: /configuration/1 ('There is no default action'), /configuration/2, /configuration/3, /configuration/5, /configuration/13, /accessibility/0 and /content/rules/3. A human should check which package version the types were read from before publishing. If the types are for 0.1.78, the evidence and guide are wrong. Otherwise these items and both examples need rewriting.
